window.description: Montgomery-Taylor window used by Lamzouri: eta^2 proportional to cos(sqrt2 u) on (-1/2, 1/2), K = (eta^2)^, K(0) = 1
window.closed_form: K(xi) = [sin((b-c)a)/(b-c) + sin((b+c)a)/(b+c)] / (2 sin(ab)/b), a = 1/2, b = sqrt2, c = 2 pi xi

C1.description: six real triples around one simple conjugate pair

C2.description: finite lattice: triples at n*s, five simple conjugate pairs per cell at n*s + o_j*s +- i y_j, |n| <= M
